_comment: Egg do Pterodactyl para o Nukkit Gold (MCPE 0.15.10, protocolo 84). Importe em Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Nukkit Gold (MCPE 0.15.10)
author: gustavoz65@users.noreply.github.com
description: Servidor Nukkit Gold para Minecraft PE 0.15.10 com anti-DDoS no RakNet. Cria o nukkit.yml em portugues na instalacao (nao pergunta o idioma) e opcionalmente instala o Pack Gold Plugins.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Instalacao do Nukkit Gold no Pterodactyl
set -e
apt update -y >/dev/null && apt install -y curl unzip >/dev/null
mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-nukkit-gold.jar}"
echo "Baixando o Nukkit Gold de ${NUKKIT_GOLD_URL}"
curl -fsSL -o "$JAR" "$NUKKIT_GOLD_URL"
# nukkit.yml em portugues: o servidor nao para pedindo o idioma
if [ ! -f nukkit.yml ]; then unzip -p "$JAR" lang/bra/nukkit.yml > nukkit.yml; fi
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then printf 'server-port=%s\nserver-ip=0.0.0.0\nmotd=Nukkit Gold\n' "${SERVER_PORT:-19132}" > server.properties; fi
mkdir -p plugins worlds
if [ -n "$PLUGINS_URL" ]; then
  echo "Baixando plugins de ${PLUGINS_URL}"
  curl -fsSL -o /tmp/pack.zip "$PLUGINS_URL"
  rm -rf /tmp/pack && mkdir /tmp/pack && unzip -q /tmp/pack.zip -d /tmp/pack
  # Versoes antigas dos plugins Gold ficariam duplicadas
  rm -f plugins/Gold*-*.jar
  find /tmp/pack -path '*/plugins/*.jar' -exec cp {} plugins/ \;
  HG="$(find /tmp/pack -type d -path '*/worlds/HG' | head -1)"
  if [ -n "$HG" ] && [ ! -d worlds/HG ]; then cp -r "$HG" worlds/; fi
fi
echo "Nukkit Gold instalado."

variables.name: URL do Nukkit Gold
variables.description: Link direto do jar (ex.: builds/nukkit-gold-0.15.10.jar do repositorio ou um anexo da release).

variables.name: URL do Pack Gold Plugins (opcional)
variables.description: Link direto do Pack-Gold-Plugins-x.y.z.zip da release. Vazio = nao instala plugins.
